name: markdownghosttables
description: Compact markdown tables that still look aligned: virtual (ghost) column alignment, per-column colors, compact/expand commands, format-on-save and optional Tab cell navigation.

commands.title: Markdown Tables: Compact tables (remove alignment padding)
Markdown Tables: Expand tables (align with real spaces)

markdownTables.ghostAlign.description: Render virtual (ghost) padding so compact tables look column-aligned on screen without writing spaces into the file.

markdownTables.ghostTint.description: Background tint of the ghost padding, so you can always tell which spaces are real and which are virtual.

markdownTables.columnColors.description: Color each table column with a subtle background (rainbow-style) for readability.

markdownTables.formatOnSave.description: Normalize all tables to this resting state when saving a markdown file. Teams can commit this per repo in .vscode/settings.json.

markdownTables.tabNavigation.description: Tab/Shift+Tab inside a table formats it and jumps between cells. Off by default; automatically yields if the Markdown Table extension (takumii.markdowntable) is installed.

markdownTables.tabFormatMode.description: How the table is formatted while navigating with Tab (real alignment is comfortable while editing; format-on-save restores the resting state).
